class.name: NNBTMoveTo2D
class.brief_description: Action leaf that navigates a [Node2D] to a target using a [NavigationAgent2D].
class.description: Drives a [NavigationAgent2D] toward the target configured by [member NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.target_source], returning [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until within [member arrival_distance] ([constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]) or if the target is unreachable or missing ([constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]). Moving targets are tracked automatically and repathed when they move past [member repath_distance]. By default, this leaf only computes and publishes the desired velocity (to the [NavigationAgent2D] and optionally [member velocity_key]) so your character script keeps full control over movement and physics. Enable [member apply_movement] if you want the leaf to move a [CharacterBody2D] or [Node2D] directly, including RVO avoidance via [signal NavigationAgent2D.velocity_computed]. Uses [member navigation_agent] if assigned, or automatically finds the actor's first [NavigationAgent2D] child.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], moves the body directly (calling [method CharacterBody2D.move_and_slide] on a [CharacterBody2D] or translating any other [Node2D]). Supports [NavigationAgent2D] avoidance automatically. Expects the root to tick every physics frame.
Distance in pixels from the target at which the leaf completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]. With avoidance enabled, keep the agent's desired distances smaller than this value.
Optional [NavigationAgent2D] to drive. When unset, uses the first direct [NavigationAgent2D] child of the actor.
Minimum target movement in pixels before submitting a new path query.
Desired movement speed in pixels per second.
Global target position when [member NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.target_source] is [constant NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.TARGET_POSITION].
Optional blackboard key where the desired [Vector2] velocity is written each tick (reset to zero when the run ends).
